title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: adding up the overdraft protection transfers a replenishment puts back
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account asks for a monthly automatic transfer that puts back what overdraft protection took from the savings account in a statement cycle. It fixes the overdraft figure that the monthly amount starts from.

## Policy clause

Add up every overdraft protection transfer of the statement cycle being put back, whichever of the customer's checking accounts it covered. Each such transfer of that cycle is included at its posted amount.

## Basis of decision

- **Authority.** The transfers, their amounts and their statement cycle are read from the savings account's transaction record.
- **Object correlation.** Only withdrawals posted as overdraft protection transfers, in that statement cycle, are added; which of the customer's checking accounts each one covered does not matter.

## Input, judgement, output

| Savings withdrawal in the cycle | Included? |
|---|---|
| overdraft protection transfer covering one of the customer's checking accounts | yes, at its posted amount |
| overdraft protection transfer covering another of the customer's checking accounts | yes, at its posted amount |
| telephone or online transfer to a checking account | no; not an overdraft protection transfer |
| overdraft protection transfer posted in an earlier cycle | no; not in the cycle being put back |
| ATM withdrawal | no |

## Worked case (hypothetical figures)

The cycle being put back contains overdraft protection transfers of USD 42.18 and USD 135.00 covering the customer's first checking account and USD 7.50 covering a second checking account, together with a USD 300.00 online transfer to the first checking account. The overdraft figure is USD 42.18, USD 135.00 and USD 7.50 together, which is USD 184.68; the online transfer is left out.

## Points of judgement

**Are overdraft transfers from an earlier cycle added?** No; only those of the cycle being put back.

**The customer has two checking accounts drawing on this savings account. Are transfers to both added?** Yes; every overdraft protection transfer of the cycle is added, whichever of the customer's checking accounts it covered.
